response.overview: We had trouble validating the language of the overview field. We detected it as Dutch but expected it to be English.  Here's a few tips to get things working like we expect:  Try entering more text. Language detection services can often have problems with small amounts of text. You can check Google Translate and play with the detection live to see if there's an update to the wording that can help. Click here to edit your text live. Sometimes we just need to update our similar language mappings table, which can be a problem when languages are similar to one another. Let us know in the forums if that's the case. If you continue to have problems, stop by the forums and let us know.
